Author's Note
Artificial Intelligence is no longer a distant concept-it is a catalyst
for how organizations innovate and stay competitive.
This handbook distills complex ideas into clear, practical insights,
enabling leaders and teams to understand Al without unnecessary
complexity.
More than a technology shift, Al represents an opportunity to
strengthen our capabilities and prepare for the future. This "ABC of
Al" is your starting point. By making Al easy to grasp, we aim to
empower every employee to see its potential and play a role in our
journey toward becoming an Al-ready organization.

P Ashok Kumar it's about uncovering stories in data,
simplifying complexity, and opening new

Al-First Lab perspective to show how Al connects to
everyday life and business.

Ethics in Al applies this same principle - how we create
and use Al systems matters just as much as what
amazing things they can do.

from men, so it started automatically rejecting qualified female candidates. This showed
why we need to carefully check Al systems for unfair biases.

accurate.

predict certain outcomes

future events

becomes available
